## Week-by-Week Detail

### First Half: Building Skills (Weeks 11-15)

**Week 11: DataLab**

- Generate the dataset you'll use all term
- Form your project groups
- No lecture 

**Week 12: Distributions & Variability**

- First lecture (2 hours)
- Mean, median, mode, standard deviation
- Introduction to R for descriptives
- *Report writing: Descriptive statistics*

**Week 13: Building Your Research**

- Operationalising variables (with real paper examples)
- Writing hypotheses (one-tailed vs two-tailed)
- Design decisions and trade-offs
- Connecting design to statistical tests
- *Assessment focus: Research Plan preparation*

**Week 14: Is Your Effect Real?**

- Null hypothesis significance testing
- p-values and significance
- Confidence intervals and effect sizes (Cohen's d)
- Independent vs paired t-tests
- Complete APA reporting
- *Report writing: t-test results with CIs and effect sizes*

**Week 15: Correlation**

- Scatterplots and relationships
- Pearson vs Spearman
- Correlation ≠ causation
- Last week before Reading Week
- *Report writing: Correlation results*

### Reading Week

- Work on your Research Plan (due Week 16)
- Review material for MCQ (Week 18)
- No taught sessions

### Second Half: Application & Assessment (Weeks 16-20)

**Week 16: Regression**

- **Research Plan due Friday**
- From correlation to prediction
- Line of best fit
- Labs now in project groups
- *Report writing: Methods section*

**Week 17: Interpretation & Credibility**

- P-hacking and HARKing
- Replication crisis
- MCQ prep in lecture
- *Report writing: Introduction section*

**Week 18: MCQ Exam**

- **MCQ Exam Monday (in lecture slot)**
- Lab is project support
- *Report writing: Introduction continued*

**Week 19: Project Workshop**

- APA results reporting
- Project analysis support
- EDS preview
- *Report writing: Discussion preview*

**Week 20: Wrapping Up**

- **EDS Assignment due Friday**
- **Lecture cancelled** — *Data Analysis I* group returns on the site (preview images); use Thursday lab for APA Results integration
- Lab: APA-style Results from returned output, module evaluation, report workshop & thank you
- *Report writing: Results from returned summaries; Discussion — interpreting findings, limitations, implications*
